_comment: A Databento gateway: one process per Databento API key serves market DATA over loopback - historical bars, the cost of a fetch before it is made, and live 1 m bars - to the Spread History page. It trades nothing. 'dataset' is Databento's (GLBX.MDP3 = CME Globex); 'symbols' are raw exchange symbols (GCZ6) or continuous ones (GC.c.0). 'live' streams 1 m bars (needs a live subscription for the dataset).
name: db_cme
